files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] kind service and entry-point main.jac; this headless slice has no npm or AI dependencies.

Define the case graph nodes with defaulted fields: DocumentNode(filename:str, content:str, doc_type:str, all ""), EvidenceNode(evidence_type:str, description:str, source_doc:str, confidence:float 0.0), TimelineNode(events:list [], fraud_start:str, fraud_end:str, total_duration_months:int 0), FalsityNode(evidence_list:list, falsity_type:str, strength_score:float, summary:str), ScientorNode(evidence_list:list, knowledge_type:str, strength_score:float, summary:str), MaterialityNode(evidence_list:list, government_relied:bool False, strength_score:float, summary:str), CausationNode(evidence_list:list, causal_chain:str, strength_score:float, summary:str) and CaseMemoNode(case_summary:str, defendant:str, total_false_claims:int, base_damages:float, treble_damages:float, per_claim_penalty:float, total_exposure:float, gap_analysis:list, overall_strength:float).

signatures.DocumentNode: node DocumentNode { has filename: str = ""; has content: str = ""; has doc_type: str = ""; }
signatures.EvidenceNode: node EvidenceNode { has evidence_type: str = ""; has description: str = ""; has source_doc: str = ""; has confidence: float = 0.0; }
signatures.TimelineNode: node TimelineNode { has events: list = []; has fraud_start: str = ""; has fraud_end: str = ""; has total_duration_months: int = 0; }
signatures.FalsityNode: node FalsityNode { has evidence_list: list = []; has falsity_type: str = ""; has strength_score: float = 0.0; has summary: str = ""; }
signatures.ScientorNode: node ScientorNode { has evidence_list: list = []; has knowledge_type: str = ""; has strength_score: float = 0.0; has summary: str = ""; }
signatures.MaterialityNode: node MaterialityNode { has evidence_list: list = []; has government_relied: bool = False; has strength_score: float = 0.0; has summary: str = ""; }
signatures.CausationNode: node CausationNode { has evidence_list: list = []; has causal_chain: str = ""; has strength_score: float = 0.0; has summary: str = ""; }
signatures.CaseMemoNode: node CaseMemoNode { has case_summary: str = ""; has defendant: str = ""; has total_false_claims: int = 0; has base_damages: float = 0.0; has treble_damages: float = 0.0; has per_claim_penalty: float = 0.0; has total_exposure: float = 0.0; has gap_analysis: list = []; has overall_strength: float = 0.0; }

files.purpose: Import DocumentNode from nodes/data_nodes.jac. Walker ingest_documents has files:list default []; on Root entry, for each file dict it creates a DocumentNode, sets filename and doc_type from the dict and content truncated to MAX_CHARS = 6000 when longer, attaches it to here, and prints a loaded message.

signatures.ingest_documents: walker ingest_documents { has files: list = []; can ingest with Root entry; }

files.purpose: Import all eight node types from nodes/data_nodes.jac and ingest_documents from walkers/ingest.jac (re-exported for API registration). Walker get_scores reports one dict {falsity, scienter, materiality, causation} taken from strength_score of FalsityNode, ScientorNode, MaterialityNode and CausationNode on root, defaulting to 0.0. get_evidence reports {type, description, source, confidence} per EvidenceNode. get_timeline reports {fraud_start, fraud_end, total_duration_months, events} per TimelineNode. reset_case deletes every DocumentNode, EvidenceNode, TimelineNode, legal-element node and CaseMemoNode on root, then reports "Case reset complete".

signatures.get_scores: walker get_scores { can run with Root entry; }
signatures.get_evidence: walker get_evidence { can run with Root entry; }
signatures.get_timeline: walker get_timeline { can run with Root entry; }
signatures.reset_case: walker reset_case { can run with Root entry; }

verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and the Jac behavior tests: ingest attaches and truncates documents, evidence and timeline reports, score defaults, and reset clears the case graph.

assumption: Backend slice of the Claimora.AI JacHacks 2026 app (debssM/Jac_2026). The LLM agent modules and the analyze_case pipeline walker are out of scope; main.jac keeps only the non-AI API walkers.
